Israel-Hezbollah conflict continues despite new framework agreement

Fighting between Israel and Hezbollah has persisted in southern Lebanon despite the signing of a framework agreement aimed at ending hostilities. Reports indicate Israeli strikes targeting suspected terrorists and Hezbollah infrastructure, while the group has rejected the agreement and vowed to continue resistance. Analysis of drone attack videos suggests Israel may be using decoys against Hezbollah's FPV drones.
